name: io.github.28naem-del/mnemosyne
title: Mnemosyne
description: Evidence-tracked local memory MCP server: one SQLite file; corrections retire dependent memories.

packageArguments.name: --db
packageArguments.description: Path to the SQLite memory file; it and its parent directory are created on first use

packageArguments.name: --workspace
packageArguments.description: Workspace name that scopes the stored memories

packageArguments.name: --agent
packageArguments.description: Agent name recorded with the memories this server writes

environmentVariables.name: MNEMOSYNE_INDEX_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Dense index used for semantic recall; defaults to auto
